content:
elaine (AE): FYI customer (AureaHealth) wants a CEO-to-CEO quick call tomorrow 8:30 PT. Top asks: guaranteed data egress controls, pilot SLA, and a commercial anchor.
nick (VP Sales): can we run 20m? they want minimal slides, more decisioning.
elaine (AE): booked 8:30. need a one-pager for execs + a clear escalation line.
omar (Solutions Eng): tech bullets I need: acceptable egress methods, KMS options, and throughput expectations for a pilot.
tara (Security): i'll draft a short compliance note: egress encryption, provable data deletion, and subprocessor list.
elaine (AE): commercial question: if they commit to 6 months Dedicated after pilot, what's a safe discount anchor?
rachel (Finance): any discount >14% needs RevOps approval. recommend starting 12-16% anchor.
omar (Solutions Eng): network note: streaming via websockets or HTTP/2 preferred; fallback to polling. confirm whether their perimeter allows long-lived connections.
bridge-bot: created brief https://redwood.app/briefs/aurea-3234567890 and invited participants.
tara (Security): security bullets added to the brief:
- Egress: TLS1.3 enforced, mutual TLS optional for private circuits
- KMS: BYO-KMS supported (cloud KMS or HSM) — integration ETA 3-5 weeks
- Data deletion: support for per-customer key rotate + zeroize on request
- Compliance: SOC2 in scope; drafting subprocessors addendum

elaine (AE): action items:
		- omar: confirm websocket allowance or polling fallback (ETA 2h)
		- tara: finalize compliance bullets in doc (ETA 3h)
		- rachel: prepare pricing anchor note + approval path (ETA 4h)
		- nick: prepare exec talking points (ETA 2h)

omar (Solutions Eng): checked with customer NETOPS: long-lived websockets are blocked. they can allow 60s polling on 443. i'll document the fallback.
elaine (AE): thanks. nick i'll put the escalation line as: escalate to nick (VP Sales) and tara (Security) for unresolved legal/compliance blockers.
nick (VP Sales): good. I'll join the CEO bridge and lead the commercial ask. if they press for deeper concessions, we escalate to RevOps.
elaine (AE): final: posting the one-pager in the brief in 45m. ping here for urgent edits.
bridge-bot: calendar invite sent to aurea-ceo@aureahealth.com and participants for 2026-05-05 08:30 PT.
